messages:
maria: Quick proposal — schedule a short 'pin sunset' to allow runtime 2.15 across hosted regions next Tue night (02:00-04:00 UTC). 2.15 fixes the kernel memleak affecting longseq + improves kvcache reuse. Planning soft-unpin (gradual ramp) with canary first. Any blockers?

deploybot: deploybot recorded: pin-sunset request created (PR #4537). Change window Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC. Canary policy: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 30/60/90m if metrics stable.

jake: question — do we have a test run for quantized Llama3q long-seq? last time we saw OOMs when seq>16k.

sam: ran perf/e2e yesterday on staging with a 12k token trace. 2.15 + sdk 1.9.3 reduces KV allocations by ~18% for that trace. The remaining failure vector is a 3rd-party tokenizer plugin (tok-fast) that still uses old buffer hints. Need a shim in SDK unless we route those jobs to dedicated pools.

anya: can we stagger regionally? if EU still has older nightly workloads let's move EU last. also prefer soft-unpin percentages: 10% -> 40% -> 100% with longer observation in first step.

maria: ack. Proposed plan updated: canary in us-west 10% for 45m, us-east 30% for 60m, then eu 40% for 60m, then global. We'll annotate model groups to avoid routing longseq or tok-fast until SDK shim lands.

maria: Rollback runbook (low-friction):
```
# emergency pin back
deploybot pin runtime=2.14 --scope=region:all --reason="pin-sunset rollback" --ticket=INC-7890
# abort ongoing rollout
deploybot abort-rollout --change=pin-sunset-4537
```
If automation fails, manually set routing-policy: model_group=longseq -> runtime=2.14

opsbot: Monitoring thresholds for auto-abort/alert:
- error_rate increase >0.5% (5m)
- p95 token latency delta >150ms (10m)
- OOM count > 3 per host (5m)
If any threshold fires, the rollout will be paused and paging will go to oncall@redwood.

jake: thx. who owns customer comms? need a short note: "runtime update: improves longseq stability; staged rollout; contact support if you see regressions".

maria: i will draft release note. Support/CS: @lucy please review tone and post to status page when we reach global.

lucy: will review. also adding a short FAQ for customers doing longseq/fine-tuning.

deploybot: Reminder — please upload the canary prompts and smoke logs to /releases/pin-sunset-4537 before start. Automated validation will fail if no artifacts.

maria: locking the plan unless objections by EOD Friday. If you have a blocking concern, reply here with details and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:

lucy: :thumbsup:

maria: thanks everyone — deploying the PR for the scheduling checklist now (PR 4540).
